_comment: Gemini CLI — merge into ~/.gemini/settings.json. `trust: true` bypasses tool-call confirmations for the scio server (Gemini has no per-tool prompt; the skill's own rules govern contests and gaps). scio_suspend is excluded outright: arbiters only. Commands (whoami.py, fetch.py) still follow general.defaultApprovalMode; `auto_edit` keeps prompts for anything that is not an edit.
